import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { users } from "./users";

// ⚠ Not reproduced exactly by `rebase db push` — read before pushing:
//   - "title" is a varchar with no length, declared as text: a push would convert it to text, which keeps every value.
//   - "sent_on" is timestamp without time zone, declared with `col.custom()`: Rebase serves it as the driver returns it, and `rebase db generate` / `db push` refuse it until the planner can plan a custom type (`custom-sql-type`).
export const messages = defineTable("messages", {
    columns: {
        id: col.bigserial().primaryKey(),
        fromUserId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        title: col.text().notNull(),
        body: col.text().notNull(),
        sentOn: col.custom("timestamp without time zone").notNull(),
        messageRead: col.boolean().notNull().default(false),
        toUserId: col.bigint().notNull(),
        toUserVisible: col.boolean().notNull().default(true),
        fromUserVisible: col.boolean().notNull().default(true),
        bodyFormat: col.enum(["html", "markdown", "text"], { name: "format_enum" }).notNull().default("markdown"),
        muted: col.boolean().notNull().default(false)
    },
    relations: {
        fromUser: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" }),
        toUser: rel.belongsTo(() => users, { onDelete: "no action" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
